How fast are the TypeScript type checkers, and do they report the same errors as tsgo? A full type check of real projects, in a fresh process with no incremental cache, every checker on the same machine in the same session.

Run 2026-10-19-apple-m5-darwin · Apple M5, 10 cores, 24 GiB · macOS 26.5.1 (25F80) · 2026-10-19 · median of 7 runs

Independent: not affiliated with or funded by Microsoft, Vercel, Oven (bun) or the authors of any checker in it.

Threads

vs tsgo

tsgo's median wall time divided by each checker's: 2.0× means the checker took half as long. Default threading differs: tsgo and tsc-rs default to 4 checkers; tsc-ts, tsrs and bun use one per core, up to 10 on this 10-core machine (sources). The other settings give every checker the same thread count, set with its documented flag.

Diagnostics compared with tsgo

Every checker ran each project twice clean and twice with a patch of planted type errors. Its output is compared with tsgo's byte for byte, and after normalising to one path:line:col code message line per error.

tsc-rs and tsrs port TypeScript 7.1.0-dev and report errors that tsgo 7.0.2 does not on the clean Outline (1) and VS Code (10); their upstream TypeScript builds report exactly the same (below).

Thread defaults and flags as each checker documents them: sources. Version output and native binary sha256: run.json.

How it was measured

  • Each timed run is a fresh process with no incremental cache or build info. The OS file cache is warm for every checker alike: each set of runs starts with a warm-up round.
  • Wall time is the median of 7 rounds; "vs tsgo" is tsgo's median divided by the checker's. Checker order within each round: rotated, each round starting one place further along.
  • Every checker runs with its shipped defaults plus the project's own typecheck arguments. No tuning flags.
  • Power: all 570 timed runs on AC. Kept awake by caffeinate. Sleep, wake and thermal events during the run: none. Preflight warnings: none.
  • A project is benchmarked only if tsgo reports 0 errors on it; rejected in this run: excalidraw.
  • Harness: bde799c06fc9 (added 2026-10-19: this run did not record it; the last harness commit before the run started and the parent of its results commit 11c0091, which changes no harness file).

Caveats and what the numbers do not show: docs/METHOD.md. Everything in this run: results/2026-10-19-apple-m5-darwin/, and its full report.
